methodology: Three alternating pairs per candidate on balanced 1M/2M/4M/8M/12M/16M/20M requests, rotating discriminants across boards. Three independent irregular-request pairs for telemetry and 20 MHz SPI. All complete serialized receipts and tampered iteration-count controls independently verified after timing. IPS is per-chain challenge-to-complete-proof receipt; chains are not additive. Differences summarize medians of the three pair-level medians; these are synthetic results, not mainnet Grafana averages.

verdict.async_telemetry: No consistent delivered-IPS gain. Removes the deliberate ADC sleep, but does not eliminate general delivery outliers. Experimental source removed from normal build.
verdict.delivery_decoupling: Do not add a sender thread. Balanced baseline complete-chain readiness-to-retrieval median 32 us, p90 213 us; checkpoint dependency wait median 47.416 ms. Keep readiness instrumentation.
verdict.ftdi_stack: FT4222 1.4.4.221 with bundled D2XX 1.4.30 passed; balanced median pair gain -0.159%. Keep existing paired FTDI stack.
verdict.spi_clock: 20 MHz passed but balanced +0.191% did not survive irregular holdout (-0.310%). Keep 10 MHz. 40 MHz failed initialization before any proof was produced; boards successfully restored.

smoke.methodology: Three boards, one physical engine per board. Identical proof targets paired with alternating trial order and rotated discriminants. IPS is per-chain iterations divided by challenge-to-complete-proof receipt time. Chains are not additive. Timings separate checkpoint dependencies from retrieval and application write completion. Small synthetic samples do not establish mainnet hourly or long-term stability gains.
